Camelia Garden brings a soft, floral bouquet that’s light and airy, while Red Jewel adds a lively twist with its juicy, fruity notes and a hint of floral sweetness.
composition: Camelia Garden, Red Jewel

name: Pearl Oud & Royal Wood Bundle
profile: A luxurious duo blending soft elegance and woody depth—Pearl Oud and Royal Wood offer a refined yet refreshing scent perfect for summer sophistication. Pearl Oud brings a smooth, creamy oud with delicate floral undertones, complemented by Royal Wood's deep, earthy notes of fine woods and subtle spice.
composition: Pearl Oud, Royal Wood

name: Oud Moza & Is It Me Bundle
profile: A daring mix of deep oud and playful sweetness—Oud Moza and Is It Me create a unique summer blend that’s bold, fun, and unforgettable. Oud Moza delivers rich, smoky oud with a modern twist, adding depth and intensity, while Is It Me brings contrast with its bright, sweet, and slightly fruity character.
composition: Oud Moza, Is It Me

name: Thaqaf & Tiff Tiff Bundle
profile: A refreshing fusion of crisp sophistication and sweet vibrance—Thaqaf and Tiff Tiff are made to brighten your summer days with elegance and charm. Thaqaf offers a clean, refined aroma with a touch of modern masculinity, while Tiff Tiff adds a lively contrast with its playful blend of sweet, fruity, and floral notes.
composition: Thaqaf, Tiff Tiff

name: House of Bakhoor Bundle
profile: Step into the House of Bakhoor – a world where tradition meets aroma. This captivating collection brings together five unique bakhoors: Bakhoor Oud & Roses, Bakhoor Asari, Bakhoor Khayali, Bakhoor Bushra, and Bakhoor Tabakhkhar.
composition: Bakhoor Oud & Roses, Bakhoor Asari, Bakhoor Khayali, Bakhoor Bushra, Bakhoor Tabakhkhar

name: Attar Majestic Bundle
profile: Experience the timeless allure of tradition with the Attar Majestic collection – a bold tribute to the finest Arabian perfumery. This unisex collection captures the essence of prestige and depth through a curated selection of luxurious attars.
composition: Ghali, Ghawi, Dehn Al Oud Kalakasi, Dehn Al Oud Ajdaad, Hayyin

name: Layers Of Luxury Bundle
profile: Step into a world of depth, elegance, and summer-ready sophistication with the Layers of Luxury collection. This unisex collection is designed to be worn in layers, offering a seamless blend of traditional oud with refreshing summer notes.
composition: Oud Lavender, Dehn Al Oud Mubakhar, Oud Ma’attar Maliki (3 Tola), Oud & Roses Hair Mist, Supreme Body Gel, Coco Blend

name: Treasures of Arabia Bundle
profile: Uncover the soul of Arabian luxury with the Treasures of Arabia collection – a celebration of scent, heritage, and summer elegance. This unisex collection brings together rich oud, charming florals, and modern twists.
composition: Dehn Al Oud Combodi Omani, Oud & Roses, Bakhoor Ghars (40 tabs), Marj Hair Mist, Hirfah Body Gel, Royal Cherry

name: Scent Library Bundle
profile: Scent Library – a curated anthology of aromas, where each fragrance tells its own unique story. This unisex collection invites you to explore a spectrum of emotions, moods, and memories through five distinct scents.
composition: Lathani, Kaaf, Tiff Tiff, Jree, Ainaak

name: Royal Collection Bundle
profile: Experience timeless elegance with the Royal Collection – a summer-perfect blend of heritage and luxury. Curated for those who appreciate depth, warmth, and sophistication, this unisex collection features a vibrant signature scent, rich oud oil, and exotic bakhoor.
composition: Marj, Dehn Al Oud Hindi Seufi, Bakhoor Hind, Rose Noir Hair Mist, Oud & Roses Body Gel, Royal Wood

name: LITTLE HEARTS GEL
key_ingredients: Lime Essence, Sweet Orange Oil, Pineapple Accord, Mango Extract, Amber Resin, White Musk, Madagascar Vanilla

fragrance_pyramid.top: Bergamot, Pink Pepper, Elemi, Nutmeg, Tangerine, Oud, Honey
fragrance_pyramid.heart: Patchouli, Aromatic Accords, Vetiver, Cashmere Wood, Cinnamon, Rose, Saffron, Jasmine, Orange Blossom
fragrance_pyramid.base: Musk, Amber, Raspberry, Saffron, Oakmoss, Powdery, Ambrette Seeds, Leather, Sandalwood, Violet, Agarwood, Ambroxan

name: OUD & ROSES GEL
key_ingredients: Turkish Rose Absolute, Frankincense Resin, Sandalwood Oil, Oud aaccord, Guaiac Wood Oil, Amber Accord
olfactory_profile: Floral-Oriental-Woody - opens with a romantic rose bouquet and soft lavender, warmed by citrus peony; the core blooms with creamy florals over deep sandalwood and frankincense; finally, a woody-musk amber base layers in rich oud, guaiac wood, and mossy depth for an enchanting dry down.

fragrance_pyramid.base: Oud Accord, Guaiac Wood, Oakmoss, Musk, Ambroxan.

sillage: Strong - powerful projection; forms a noticeable scent bubble in the first few hours
longevity: Excellent - lasting 12+ hours on skin, with notable sticking power on fabrics

name: SUPREME GEL
key_ingredients: Pear Essence, Melon Accord, Rose Absolute, Freesia Petals, Patchouli Oil, Amber, White Musk
olfactory_profile: Fruity-Floral-Musky - a juicy pear and melon sparkle meet delicate freesia and rose, all resting on a warm patchouli-amber-musk base for an elegantly smooth dry-down.
sillage: Moderate - softly radiates a clean yet vibrant aura
longevity: 6-8 hours on skin; 12+ hours on fabrics
